summary: Held curl at 7.16.4-2ubuntu1 using the Ubuntu 7.10-compatible dpkg mechanism. The hold persisted through a full node reboot; the OS release and kernel remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Captured the initial Ubuntu release, kernel, curl version, package state, and boot identity.
Set curl's dpkg selection to hold.
Confirmed an apt upgrade simulation leaves curl unchanged.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed after reboot that curl remains installed, functional, held at 7.16.4-2ubuntu1, and excluded from the simulated update.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
evidence.summary: curl changed from the normal install selection to hold. Upgrade simulations before and after reboot retained version 7.16.4-2ubuntu1.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel

evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot ID was 72ac741f-1ec3-49fe-8369-e2ff05c857dc; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID was 7e1f3a32-9c17-41f1-ad6e-e469135b51f7. curl recovered functional and held at the required version.
